title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode8 Encouragement Taken to Heart

meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: The next day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's amazing, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yo... Ho...
se_event_unfading_2024_009

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're so good at juggling, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! It feels like magic for some reason!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I was able to figure out how to do this after watching Airi and the others play.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Kendama, marbles, juggling...
All the toys you bought for us are so much fun, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, thank you so much for getting these for us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. We made sure to test them out before buying, so your satisfaction is guaranteed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We even got a chance to play some competitive Hanetsuki, and the four of us had a really fun match!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The four of you?
I thought you went shopping with just Ena yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, we ran into Akito and Toya yesterday, and we decided to go to the mall together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow, what are the odds?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Also, Akito and Ena going shopping together on New Year's Day must mean they're very close!
I'm actually a little jealous...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As in Shinonome...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I didn't know that Ena and Shinonome were siblings!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, were neither of you aware?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought you two already did...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No. I've met both of them before, but I didn't know that they were brother and sister.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But now that you mention it, their personalities are somewhat similar...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, they do have a lot in common.
Especially how they both hate to lose.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should've seen how competitive things got when we played Hanetsuki yesterday. Neither of them was willing to let the other win.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They really do get along.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, that counts as getting along...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, she might be right. After all, they say that close friends get into arguments all the time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's have ourselves a test Hanetsuki match before we do this live during our stream!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If we're gonna keep spreading hope to lots of people this year, then we gotta give it everything we've got!!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Darn it! We lost again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is so frustrating! We only managed to score two points!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. To be fair, that smash shot you hit did catch me off guard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
If this is all you two have got, then you don't have any hope of defeating Miku and MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grrrr!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Let's have a rematch!
We're not gonna lose this time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They certainly sound motivated.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad that they're enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We had quite a lot of fun during our match yesterday, so it's nice to be able to share that with all of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Akito, you ended up playing with your sister and her friend, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Playing Hanetsuki together? You two are really close.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hardly.
That's just what ended up happening.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, I am glad that I had a chance to talk to Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: With Airi?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she's been friends with Ena since junior high. So we've talked a few times.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
She takes the time to talk to her friend's siblings? That's so kind of her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What did you two talk about yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I thanked her for being Ena's friend all this time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You thanked her...?
Hehe. It's so like you to do that, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! Akito's so old-fashioned when it comes to these sorts of things!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
If you ask me, it's pretty normal to thank those who've helped out your family.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's what I'm talking about!
You're like... A chivalrous samurai or something!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, you keep believing whatever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Still, I'm glad that I got a chance to tell her how I felt.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It was nice to be reminded of how those around us are genuinely hoping that we make our dream a reality.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means we need to keep finding ways to move forward.)
